items.html: And it is that in the evening prayer, the illumination of the Mochin from the day remained in him, except that its time and season is night. But the Shema of the sacrifices is drawn from the night, from which no illumination remained for him. But it has another advantage, and it is that its time and season is day. And it is found that in one aspect it is equal to the Shema of the evening, and in another aspect it is higher and more excellent than it.
